title: Spend Runway Diagnostic QuickSheet
content:
Spend Runway Diagnostic QuickSheet - purpose: one-page worksheet to prep usage & billing section of QBRs (concise, action-focused).

1) Snapshot (fill for review period)
- Account: ____________
- QBR period: ____________ -> ____________
- Plan type / tier: ____________
- Contract renewal date: ____________

2) Key numbers (period totals + delta vs prior period)
- Total tokens consumed: ______ (delta: +/-% )
- Billable tokens (hosted): ______
- Effective $/1k tokens last period: $_____
- Avg tokens/day: ______
- Peak tokens/hour (date/time): ______
- Top 3 routes by token share (route: %): 1) _____ 2) _____ 3) _____
- Top model(s) used (model: % tokens): _____

Guidance: call out if any single route >40% or model >50% of tokens. Triggers a prioritized action below.

3) Rate-limit & throttling log (incidents in period)
- # incidents: _____
- Severity: low/medium/high (count): L=__, M=__, H=__
- Example incident (timestamp + route + error): 
  - _____
- Root cause hypothesis (capacity | bug | spiky UX | misconfiguration): _____
- Sticky symptoms still present? (yes/no) 

4) Budget alerts & billing exceptions
- Alerts triggered (count): _____ (list IDs): _____
- Over-spend tolerance set: _____
- Any auto-ratecap events fired (date/time): _____
- Current committed spend vs forecast for next 30d: $_____ vs $_____
- Immediate guardrail recommended (dropdown): lower-ratecap / quota / model-substitution / caching-rule / prefix-cache

5) Runway / forecast mini-scenario (3-point)
- Conservative (flat): tokens/day = ___ -> runway days to next invoice = ___
- Base (trend continues): tokens/day = ___ -> runway = ___
- Risk (30% growth): tokens/day = ___ -> runway = ___
Notes: compute using avg cost per token and committed credits.

6) Quality & customer experience signals (impacting renewal)
- Notable quality regressions flagged in evals? (y/n) 
- Customer-reported latency/timeout issues? (y/n)
- User-facing errors correlated with rate-limit events? (y/n)
- Representative customer quote / CS note: "_____"

7) Playbook actions (checklist, owner, ETA)
- Short-term (0-7 days):
  - Apply emergency ratecap change (owner: _____) [ ]
  - Open infra support ticket & attach logs (JIRA: _____) [ ]
  - Add temporary model-substitution fallback (owner: _____) [ ]
- Medium-term (7-30 days):
  - Implement route-level caching for top route (owner: _____) [ ]
  - Policy: adjust daily token quota & alert thresholds (owner: _____) [ ]
  - Build small eval to validate model-sub substitution impact on quality (owner: _____) [ ]
- Long-term (30-90 days):
  - Recommend committed capacity or Dedicated quote if steady high throughput (owner: _____) [ ]
  - Review product and UX flows to limit gratuitous refreshes (owner: _____) [ ]

Escalation matrix:
- CS AE -> CS Manager -> Solutions Eng -> Eng SRE (include pager if high severity)
- Thresholds for escalation: more than 3 high-severity incidents in 7d OR unexpected >25% overspend vs forecast.

8) Renewal risk scorecard (quick rubric)
- Usage trend: (improving/flat/declining) -> +1/0/-1
- Billing surprises: (none/minor/major) -> +1/0/-2
- Reliability: (stable/intermittent/ongoing) -> +1/0/-2
- CS sentiment: (advocate/neutral/concerned) -> +1/0/-2
- Final quick score (sum): _____  (>=1 low risk, 0 neutral, <=-1 elevated risk)

9) Suggested talking points for QBR (short bullets)
- Headline number (period tokens and spend) + change vs prior period.
- What caused any spike and how we mitigated it.
- Proposed immediate guardrail and why it’s safe for their UX.
- If renewal approaching: propose a capacity/discount pathway tied to predictable usage.

10) Attachments & evidence to include with QBR packet
- Token-by-route export (CSV)
- Top-10 hourly heatmap (PNG)
- Rate-limit incident timeline (JIRA link)
- Alert history export (CSV)

11) Sample short templated email to customer (CS to edit)
Subject: Quick usage & billing snapshot ahead of our QBR
Hi [Name],
We pulled a short usage snapshot for the quarter: total tokens = [x], cost = [$y], we saw a single-day spike on [date] caused by [root cause]. We’ve applied a short-term guardrail and propose [recommendation] to avoid surprises. Can we sync for 20m before the QBR to go through the numbers?
Thanks, [CS rep]

12) Open questions (to capture during prep)
- Has the customer added any new integrations or automations this period?
- Are there internal business events (marketing, product launches) that could affect next quarter usage?
- Are billing contacts correct for escalation?

Notes / Running log (for CS):
- [2026-02-25] small bot loop caused repeated completions on /chat/summary; mitigated by temporary ratecap. Ticket JIRA-CS-2481.
- [2026-01-12] alert threshold adjustment lowered false positives.

End of QuickSheet. Use as a single-page prep for QBR slide + appendix artifacts.
